checks.evidence: The Staff Responsible tests (titles 2 and 3) check remaining distance = SR distance minus corrected distance travelled with under-/over-reading correction, but none covers the reference scenario of an SR distance already covered, a driver extension request and an RBC-granted new SR distance in Level 2. They also do not use the max safe front end as the supervised front, since the under-reading correction is added to the distance travelled.
